title: chore(gateway): remove unused context_as_json shutdown forensics helper
claim: gateway.shutdown_forensics.context_as_json has no production caller (the snapshot is only rendered via format_context_for_log) and can be removed with its json import.

evidence.source: main: the only production consumers of shutdown_forensics are gateway/run.py:5307-5343 (snapshot_shutdown_context, format_context_for_log, spawn_async_diagnostic), run_startup.py:960 (check_systemd_timing_alignment), hermes_cli/gateway.py:1392 and update_cmd_fleet.py:732 (parse_systemd_duration_to_us). `json` in shutdown_forensics.py is used only by context_as_json (:195). Not in old_updater_surface.json; that file lists only parse_systemd_duration_to_us from this module.
evidence.references_before: main: def at gateway/shutdown_forensics.py:192; tests/gateway/test_shutdown_forensics.py:38 (header), :45 (unit test), :83 (argv-canary assert).
evidence.negative_control: The #112459 argv-canary assertion now checks `repr(ctx)` instead of the dead serializer. To prove it still guards the whole snapshot, _proc_summary was temporarily made to store the child's argv under a new key 'args'. Result: test_snapshot_and_log_line_identify_process_without_argv FAILS on the repr(ctx) half while the log-line half passes. Restored byte-identically.
evidence.adjacent: test_shutdown_forensics, test_planned_stop_watcher, test_launchd_exit_timeout_drain_cap pass (in the 715/0/1 gateway bundle run). check-windows-footguns flags 2 pre-existing encoding='utf-8' reads in test_shutdown_forensics.py, identical on main.

upstream_overlap: #112508 (JoaoMarcos44, OPEN) references context_as_json only in tests; its fix already landed as #113075 (teknium1 salvage, MERGED), so it is effectively superseded.
#59929 (ilanoh, OPEN) mentions context_as_json only in tests.
notes: Deviation from fork #285: it simply dropped the JSON half of the argv-canary assert. This rebuild keeps equivalent coverage with `repr(ctx)`. Bundle commit 3d721162fc.
